subject: ela
intro: Find meanings using context, roots, or references.

items.prompt:
Read.

The room was immaculate, not a speck of dust anywhere.

'Immaculate' means:
A) perfectly clean
B) very dirty
C) dark

To find a SYNONYM for a word, use a:
A) thesaurus
B) map
C) calendar

To find a word's MEANING and part of speech, use a:
A) dictionary
B) ruler
C) clock

Read.

The detective was perceptive; she noticed clues others missed.

'Perceptive' means:
A) quick to notice things
B) careless
C) tired

steps: She noticed clues. Key is A.

items.prompt:
'Portable' uses the root 'port' (carry). It means able to be:
A) carried
B) eaten
C) seen

Read.

He was reluctant and really did not want to go.

'Reluctant' means:
A) eager
B) unwilling
C) happy

steps: Did not want to go. Key is B.

items.prompt:
'Benefactor' uses 'bene' (good) and 'fact' (do). It means:
A) a person who does good / gives help
B) a villain
C) a building
items.answer: A) a person who does good / gives help

solution.answer: A) a person who does good / gives help

items.prompt:
Read.

The critic's review was scathing; it harshly attacked every scene.

'Scathing' means:
A) gentle and kind
B) harshly critical
C) confusing
